_doc: Mission file (openspec/changes/mission-scripting; the format is docs/design/mission-files.md). Edit with tools/mission-editor or by hand.
name: Belt patrol
objective: Patrol the asteroid field and engage the raiders.

brief.text: Prospectors in this field report raiders lying among the rocks to jump their haulers. Patrol the field and see them off.
Keep your speed down near the rocks.

result.log: Belt patrol: outnumbered among the rocks, the fleet drew off.
